title: REQ · Admin can approve and retry executions
summary: Approve and Retry buttons call execution endpoints with the Bearer token
description: Context: POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve works for AWAITING_APPROVAL and /retry for FAILED, answering 409 otherwise. Desired behavior: ExecutionPanel shows Approve when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and Retry when FAILED, calls the endpoint, reloads executions, and shows the 409 message on conflict. There is no reject endpoint, so no Reject call is made. Why: admin supervises publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given AWAITING_APPROVAL, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve runs with the Bearer header
Given FAILED, when Retry is clicked, then POST .../retry runs
Given other statuses, then neither button renders
Given a 409, then the error text is shown and buttons remain
technical_constraints: Reject is excluded because the backend lacks it
clarifying_questions: The backend has no reject endpoint; should Reject be added later as a backend ticket?
